description: Defines the QuicDecrypter class, an abstract interface for decrypting QUIC packets within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicDecrypter
classes.description: Abstract interface for QUIC packet decryption, supporting key management, decryption, header protection, and cipher identification.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a QuicDecrypter instance based on QUIC version and algorithm.

methods.name: CreateFromCipherSuite
methods.description: Factory method to create a QuicDecrypter based on cipher suite ID.

methods.name: SetPreliminaryKey
methods.description: Sets the initial encryption key; must be called before decryption.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Derives final keys using a nonce after preliminary key is set.

methods.name: DecryptPacket
methods.description: Decrypts a packet given packet number, associated data, and ciphertext.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderProtectionMask
methods.description: Generates a mask for header protection from sample data.

methods.name: cipher_id
methods.description: Returns the cipher ID used by the decrypter.

methods.name: GetIntegrityLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of packets that can fail decryption safely.

methods.name: GetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Returns the nonce prefix used in decryption.
